name: Hutton Hotel
positioning: Music-focused hotel in Midtown Nashville, designed like the home base of a touring artist, with its own live music venue and songwriting studios
best_for: Music lovers who want live performances and songwriting studios under the same roof
Travelers who want a Midtown Nashville base on West End Avenue

facts.text: Hutton Hotel is in the heart of Midtown Nashville.
The hotel's address is 1808 West End Avenue, Nashville.
The hotel is designed with real artists in mind: what they need, how they create and how they really live.
The hotel's art collection highlights emerging and established talent, local and beyond.
The hotel's common spaces often host pop-up performances and impromptu sets.
Rooms have a Marshall Acton III Bluetooth speaker and a Dyson Supersonic hairdryer.
The Superior King room has a dedicated in-room workout area and a wellness basket with a yoga mat, dumbbells and a foam roller.
Penthouse East has a private south-facing balcony, a kitchenette, dining for six and a marble fireplace.
Mimi's Lobby Bar serves coffee and pastries by day and becomes a neighborhood bar with craft cocktails by night.
The fitness center has high-performance equipment and natural light.
Conde Nast Traveler calls the Hutton Nashville's original boutique hotel.

highlights.text: Analog is the hotel's in-house live music venue, intimate, acoustically dialed-in and designed to honor live performance.
The hotel has Writers' Studios with professional-grade gear, a nod to the city's songwriting legacy.
Room stays include Fender Play, a vinyl library and a 20% discount on shows at Analog.
The Hutton Suite is a two-level, three-bedroom residence with a chef's kitchen, a dining room and a dedicated writing room.
At Evelyn's, the hotel's Modern Americana restaurant, beloved Southern classics find a fresh perspective.

considerations.text: Conde Nast Traveler notes the rooms are not large, though smartly designed.
The spa's sauna, cold plunge and salt room are complimentary with a scheduled treatment, and time in them must be reserved by calling once the appointment is booked.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.
